title: C3.ai, Inc. (AI) Reports Q1 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
author: Na
description: C3.ai reported a quarterly loss of $0.2 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.26 loss, with a 23.08% earnings surprise. However, revenues declined year-over-year to $52.38 million. The stock has lost 23.3% since the beginning of the year and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the company beat EPS estimates, revenues declined significantly year-over-year ($52.38M vs $70.26M), the stock has underperformed the market by 34.8 percentage points YTD, and it carries a Hold rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting limited near-term upside.

Accenture has not yet reported results but is expected to post earnings of $3.19 per share with 5.3% year-over-year growth and 2.4% revenue growth. Consensus estimates have remained unchanged, indicating stable but unexciting expectations.

title: Blockchain Market Surges to $610.96 billion at a CAGR 62.4% by 2031 | Report by MarketsandMarkets™

title: Strategy Consulting Market Projected to Reach $194.56 Billion by 2035 | Research by SNS Insider
author: Unknown
description: The global strategy consulting market, valued at $81.51 billion in 2025, is expected to grow to $194.56 billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 9.09%. Growth is driven by digital transformation, AI-powered advisory services, ESG consulting, and enterprise demand for business strategy. The U.S. market is projected to reach $54.39 billion by 2035, while Europe is expected to hit $53.42 billion. Key segments include Corporate Strategy (33% share), Digital Strategy (fastest growth), and Advisory services (49% share).

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Acquired Maryville Consulting Group in July 2025 to strengthen digital transformation and technology business management capabilities, directly aligning with market growth drivers.

title: Momentum Cyber Mid-Year 2026 Review: Cybersecurity M&A on Track for Highest Deal Count Ever Tracked
author: Momentum Cyber
description: The cybersecurity market experienced a historic first half of 2026 with 219 M&A transactions totaling $9.1B in disclosed deal value. AI Security has matured into a dominant M&A reality, driving enterprise platform consolidation. Accenture's $4.175B acquisition of Dragos, NetRise, and runZero marked the year's first mega-deal, signaling aggressive strategic restructuring where scaled platform vendors command premiums while point solutions struggle.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Accenture executed a landmark $4.175B acquisition of three cybersecurity companies (Dragos, NetRise, runZero), demonstrating aggressive strategic positioning and confidence in the cybersecurity market consolidation trend.
